name: Sugar
disadvantage: Too much raises blood sugar and adds empty calories; matters most for diabetes and weight control.

name: High fructose corn syrup
what: Cheap liquid sweetener common in drinks.
disadvantage: Easy to overconsume; linked with weight gain and fatty liver at high intake.

name: Palm oil
advantage: Crisp texture and long shelf life.
disadvantage: High in saturated fat; frequent intake can raise cholesterol.

name: Trans fat (hydrogenated oil)
what: Fat hardened for texture and shelf life.
disadvantage: Raises bad cholesterol and heart-disease risk; keep as low as possible.

name: Sodium nitrite / nitrate
disadvantage: Can form nitrosamines linked to higher cancer risk with frequent processed-meat intake.

name: Tartrazine and azo colours
disadvantage: Linked to hyperactivity in some children and reactions in sensitive people.

name: Potassium bromate
disadvantage: Possible carcinogen; banned for food use in India and several other countries.

name: Titanium dioxide (E171)
disadvantage: Banned as a food additive in the EU over genotoxicity concerns.

name: Sodium benzoate
disadvantage: Can form benzene with vitamin C plus heat or light; some people react to it.

name: MSG (monosodium glutamate)
disadvantage: Considered safe in normal amounts; a few people report headache or flushing.

name: Artificial sweeteners
disadvantage: People with phenylketonuria must avoid aspartame; long-term effects still debated.

name: BHA / BHT
disadvantage: BHA is a possible carcinogen at high doses; limit regular intake.

name: Salt / sodium
disadvantage: Excess raises blood pressure; check sodium per serving.

name: Whole grain / millets
advantage: Fibre, steadier blood sugar, more minerals.
disadvantage: Wheat and oats contain gluten for people who avoid it.

name: Turmeric / natural spices
disadvantage: Large supplement doses can upset the stomach; food amounts are fine.

name: Citric acid / Vitamin C
advantage: Keeps food fresh; vitamin C adds nutrition.
disadvantage: Very acidic drinks can wear tooth enamel.

name: Niacinamide (vitamin B3)
advantage: Fades dark spots, controls oil, calms redness; suits all skin tones.
disadvantage: High strengths (10%+) may sting sensitive skin.

name: Hyaluronic acid
advantage: Plumps and hydrates without clogging pores.
disadvantage: Apply on damp skin; in very dry air it can pull moisture out.

name: Glycerin
advantage: Gentle hydration for most skin types.
disadvantage: Rarely irritating.

name: Ceramides
advantage: Repair the barrier and lock in moisture.
disadvantage: Very few concerns.

name: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid)
advantage: Helps fade dark spots and protects from sun damage.
disadvantage: Can sting; unstable in light and air. Always use sunscreen.

name: Salicylic acid
disadvantage: Can dry or irritate; ask a doctor if pregnant.

name: Glycolic / lactic acid (AHA)
disadvantage: Increases sun sensitivity; strong use on deeper tones can leave dark marks if it irritates.

name: Retinol / retinoids
advantage: Smooths lines and helps acne and uneven tone.
disadvantage: Dryness and peeling at first; not advised in pregnancy; sunscreen is a must.

name: Zinc oxide / mineral UV filter
advantage: Gentle broad protection; good for sensitive skin.
disadvantage: Untinted versions can leave a white cast, most visible on medium to deep skin.

name: Chemical UV filters
disadvantage: Oxybenzone and octinoxate may irritate some skin and harm reefs.

name: Fragrance / parfum
disadvantage: Common cause of irritation and contact allergy; avoid for sensitive skin.

name: Parabens
disadvantage: Debated hormone concerns; permitted in small amounts by regulators.

name: Sulfates (SLS / SLES)
disadvantage: Can dry skin and scalp and fade hair colour.

name: Alcohol denat.
disadvantage: Drying and stinging for dry or sensitive skin.

name: Hydroquinone
disadvantage: Use only under medical supervision; long use can cause ochronosis (darkening), more risk on deeper skin.

name: Mercury / steroid creams
disadvantage: Toxic or thins skin; avoid any cream listing these.

name: Kojic acid
disadvantage: Can irritate or cause contact allergy.

name: Benzoyl peroxide
disadvantage: Dry and bleaches fabric; start at 2.5%.

name: Mineral oil / petrolatum
advantage: Locks in moisture; cosmetic grades are well tolerated.
disadvantage: Heavy; may trigger breakouts on oily skin.

name: Dimethicone / silicones
disadvantage: Can build up on hair and trap oil on acne-prone skin.

name: Aloe vera
disadvantage: Rare allergy.

name: Shea butter
advantage: Deep moisture for dry skin and hair.
disadvantage: Heavy on oily or acne-prone skin.

name: Triclosan / formaldehyde releasers
disadvantage: Can release formaldehyde or irritate; avoid where alternatives exist.

name: Water (aqua)
disadvantage: No concern by itself.

name: Refined wheat flour (maida)
aliases: refined wheat flour|maida|wheat flour|enriched flour|refined flour
what: Finely milled wheat with the bran removed.
disadvantage: Low in fibre and raises blood sugar quickly; limit if watching weight or sugar.

name: Vegetable oils
aliases: vegetable oil|sunflower oil|groundnut oil|peanut oil|rapeseed oil|canola oil|soybean oil|sesame oil|rice bran oil|coconut oil|mustard oil
advantage: Energy and some essential fatty acids.
disadvantage: Large amounts add calories; re-heated oil is best avoided.

name: Maltodextrin
what: Processed starch used as filler and sweetener.
disadvantage: Raises blood sugar very quickly; a concern for diabetes.

name: Caramel colour
what: Brown colouring made by heating sugars.
disadvantage: Some types (E150c/d) contain 4-MEI, a possible carcinogen at high intake.

name: Natural / artificial flavour
disadvantage: Exact chemicals are not listed; 'natural' does not automatically mean healthier.

name: Yeast extract
aliases: yeast extract|hydrolysed vegetable protein|hydrolyzed vegetable protein
disadvantage: Naturally contains glutamates and can be high in sodium.

name: Gums and thickeners
advantage: Smooth texture and keeps ingredients mixed.
disadvantage: Large amounts can cause bloating in some people.

name: Lecithin (emulsifier)
disadvantage: Soy lecithin comes from soy; usually tolerated in tiny amounts.

name: Milk solids
disadvantage: Not suitable if you avoid dairy or are lactose intolerant.

name: Raising agents
disadvantage: Adds a little sodium.

name: Water (aqua)
disadvantage: No concern by itself.

name: Cetyl / cetearyl alcohol
what: Fatty alcohols that soften and thicken.
advantage: Soften skin; unlike drying alcohol they are gentle.
disadvantage: Rarely, contact sensitivity.

name: Gentle preservatives
advantage: Keep the product free from bacteria and mould.
disadvantage: Can irritate very sensitive skin; limited to 1% in many regions.

name: Gel thickeners
disadvantage: Usually well tolerated.

name: Vitamin E (tocopherol)
disadvantage: Rare contact irritation.

name: Panthenol (pro-vitamin B5)
advantage: Calms and helps repair the skin barrier.
disadvantage: Very well tolerated.

name: Allantoin
disadvantage: Very well tolerated.

name: PEG compounds
advantage: Mix oil and water for smooth creams.
disadvantage: Can irritate broken skin; impurities possible in poor-quality grades.

name: Glycols (propylene, butylene)
advantage: Help ingredients absorb and hold moisture.
disadvantage: Propylene glycol can irritate sensitive skin.

name: Mild cleansers
advantage: Cleanse with less dryness than sulfates.
disadvantage: Cocamidopropyl betaine can cause allergy in a few people.

name: EDTA
what: Chelating agent that stabilises the formula.
advantage: Keeps the product fresh and effective.
disadvantage: Generally safe in cosmetics.

name: Iron oxides / CI pigments
disadvantage: Cosmetic grade is generally safe.

name: Spices and seasonings
advantage: Add taste without extra salt or sugar; many have antioxidants.
disadvantage: Hot spices can upset a sensitive stomach.

name: Hydrolysed protein flavour
aliases: hydrolysed groundnut|hydrolyzed groundnut|hydrolysed soy|hydrolysed protein|hydrolyzed protein
what: Protein broken down to boost savoury taste.
disadvantage: Can be high in sodium; groundnut or soy types matter if you avoid those foods.

name: Wheat gluten
what: Wheat protein that gives dough elasticity.
disadvantage: Contains gluten; avoid with coeliac disease.

name: Starch
disadvantage: Mostly refined carbohydrate.
